title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — We Fight
Indiana's Wabash Valley Correctional Facility is an isolated fortress with three officers for every 200 inmates; some inmates find themselves in racial conflict, while others seek conflict elsewhere.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Da Future
With over 2,000 inmates, the Wabash Valley Correctional Facility has a larger population and more acreage than the small town in which it's located; after a decade in confinement, one of Indiana's most infamous inmates moves to general population.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Father Figure

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
